rules: ALL prices, countdowns, funding rates, and volumetric data MUST use JetBrains Mono.
Use tabular-nums class for all data to prevent layout shift during live ticks.
UI elements (Tabs, Button labels, Modal titles) use Manrope.

desktop.right_panel: Default width: 320px. Must be resizable horizontally. Contains Watchlist, Alarms, Futures Data modules (resizable vertically).

mobile.right_panel: Transforms into a bottom sheet using framer-motion. Handles touch gestures.
mobile.toolbar: Moves to a scrollable bottom bar or horizontal top sub-nav.

component_instructions.buttons: Sharp edges (rounded-none) or subtle (rounded-sm). No heavy shadows. 1px borders.
component_instructions.tables_and_lists: High density. py-1 px-2. No internal borders. Hover state uses bg-white/5.
component_instructions.modals: Use for Indicator settings. Backdrop-blur-sm bg-black/60. Surface bg-[#0A0A0A] border border-white/10.
component_instructions.tabs: Underline style. text-[#787B86] hover:text-[#E0E3EB]. Active state gets border-b-2 border-[#2962FF] and text-[#2962FF].

auth_background.description: Dark textured plaster wall. Use at 10-15% opacity behind the login/register forms to break the digital flatness.

UNIVERSAL_GUIDELINES_FOR_MAIN_AGENT: All interactive and key informational elements MUST include a data-testid attribute (e.g., data-testid='watchlist-tab-favorites').
DO NOT use complete transparent background in header, overlays, or any surface that has content under it. Use solid #0A0A0A or backdrop-blur with bg-black/80.
You MUST NOT apply universal transition (transition: all). Target specific properties (transition-colors, transition-transform).
Never center-align dense tabular data. Left-align labels, right-align numerical values.
Ensure minimum 44x44px touch targets for mobile PWA usability.
Use lucide-react for UI icons. Use framer-motion for the mobile bottom sheet and modal entrances.
